posts.author: Hans
posts.content_md: Does anyone know what happens when you centrifuge liquid gelatin in a centrifuge? I would like to try to centrifuge a dispersion of low concentration AgBr crystals in liquid gelatin + water in hopes of collecting a higher concentration of AgBr with relation to the gelatin in the bottom of the test tube. But before I buy a centrifuge I hope to learn if this procedure has any chance of success.
